The Story

So, What Does Your Hair Need Today?

Something brought you to this page. Before you call, before you drive over, name it. Which one sounds like you?

First

It Grew Out

You have been putting it off for weeks and it shows. You need the full reset, the whole cut done right so you walk out looking like yourself again.

Second

It Just Needs a Trim

The shape is fine, it is just shaggy around the edges. A clean trim, the neck shaved clean, and you are back in business.

Third

You Want It Sharp

A fade with a clean lineup, crisp edges, the kind of cut people notice. Say the word in the chair and that is what you get.

“Cuts to meet the needs of your time!”

That is the promise on Scott’s own business card, and it is still the promise in the chair.

The Story

No Booking. No Runaround. Just Walk In.

Here is what a lot of people do not realize until somebody tells them. Most shops make you book days out, download an app, or wait on a callback. The Cutt Hutt never worked that way. In Scott’s own words, from the shop’s page:

“I work all kind of hours to make sure everyone get service. NO APPOINTMENTS NEEDED!”Scott Dickerson, The Cutt Hutt on Facebook

When your hair needs cutting, you come by. That is the whole system.

The Story

One Shop. One Owner. Scott Dickerson.

The Cutt Hutt is a small wooden shop on N Lynnbank Road with THE CUTT HUTT in big white letters, barber pole lanterns by the door, and a neon OPEN BARBER sign in the window. A window sign says it plain: BARBER SHOP, WALK INS WELCOME.

Scott describes his own shop as “a family and friendly atmosphere, where everyone is welcome, all ages, and walk ins.” You deal with the owner himself, the man whose name is on the card, not a stranger behind a counter.

The Cutt Hutt Guarantee

If the cut isn’t clean, we fix it free, right there in the chair. Speak up before you leave and Scott makes it right on the spot. No charge for the fix, no hard feelings. That is the deal, every time.
